author: Shrimpy
body:
Walls is one of my favorite minigames on this server. I absolutely love it, but now there's barely any servers for them now. Every time I want to play walls I have to wait nearly 15 minutes for a match to start which makes binge-playing quite difficult and time-consuming.

What ever happened to the dozen walls servers there used to be? I used to like having the option to pick among many.

Bronson a.k.a. TheBron_cool
